CREATE TABLE change_outbox (
            sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            event_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('event', 'gap')),
            payload TEXT,
            UNIQUE (operation_id, event_index)
        )

CREATE TABLE change_outbox_consumers (
            consumer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            checkpoint INTEGER NOT NULL,
            durable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (durable IN (0, 1)),
            updated_at_epoch REAL NOT NULL
        , lease_owner TEXT, lease_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_expires_at_epoch REAL, owner_instance TEXT, registration_expires_at_epoch REAL)

CREATE TABLE change_outbox_identities (
            operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            event_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, event_kind TEXT, effect_hash TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (operation_id, event_index),
            UNIQUE (sequence)
        )

CREATE TABLE change_outbox_state (
            singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
            pruned_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )

CREATE TABLE collections (
                        collection_id INTEGER,
                        db_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        coll_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        options_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                        PRIMARY KEY (db_name, coll_name)
                    )

CREATE TABLE documents (
                        db_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        coll_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        document TEXT NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (db_name, coll_name, storage_key)
                    )

CREATE TABLE indexes (
                        db_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        coll_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        physical_name TEXT,
                        fields TEXT NOT NULL,
                        keys TEXT,
                        unique_flag INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        sparse_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        hidden_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        collation_json TEXT,
                        partial_filter_json TEXT,
                        expire_after_seconds INTEGER,
                        text_weights_json TEXT,
                        default_language TEXT,
                        language_override TEXT,
                        min_value REAL,
                        max_value REAL,
                        bucket_size REAL,
                        multikey_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        multikey_physical_name TEXT, scalar_physical_name TEXT,
                        PRIMARY KEY (db_name, coll_name, name)
                    )

CREATE TABLE mongoeco_schema_migrations (
            component TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            version INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE multikey_entries (
                        collection_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        index_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        element_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                        type_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
                        element_key TEXT NOT NULL
                    )

CREATE TABLE scalar_index_entries (
                        collection_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        index_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        element_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                        type_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
                        element_key TEXT NOT NULL
                    )

CREATE TABLE search_indexes (
                        db_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        coll_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        index_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                        definition_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                        ready_at_epoch REAL, physical_name TEXT,
                        PRIMARY KEY (db_name, coll_name, name)
                    )

CREATE TABLE ttl_index_entries (
                        collection_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        index_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        expires_at_epoch_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (collection_id, index_name, storage_key)
                    ) WITHOUT ROWID
